part.text:
Fixed the bug in `mutateIfMutable` at src/Carbon/Traits/Date.php:3555. When `$this` is immutable, it returned `$this` (the unmodified original) instead of the computed boundary `$date`, so `setUnitNoOverflow` on immutable instances silently discarded the clamping. Now it returns `$date`.

Verified:
- `Carbon::parse('2024-02-29')->toImmutable()->setUnitNoOverFlow('day', 31, 'month')` now yields `2024-02-29 23:59:59`
- All 107 setter tests pass, and the full Carbon/CarbonImmutable suites show only 2 pre-existing failures (confirmed unrelated by stashing the fix and re-running)
